title: Timeline
description: Unified chronological index of milestones, optionally pointing back to a full entry in experience.json, education.json, projects.json or certifications.json. Powers a single narrative timeline and lets AI tools answer questions like "what happened in 2025" without scanning every file.

endDate.description: Optional end of a period; null for single-point milestones.

refId.description: Id of the corresponding entry in its source file (e.g. an id from experience.json). Null when type is "milestone" and there is no source entry.

icon.description: Icon slug used by the frontend to render this node.

order.description: Manual sort order, ascending, within this file.

visible.description: Toggle to hide the entry without deleting it.
